description.zh: 专注 API、领域建模、数据库、异步处理、安全、可观测性和服务可靠性的后端专家。
description.en: Backend specialist in APIs, domain modeling, databases, async processing, security, observability, and service reliability.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我接口、数据或服务问题，我会从契约到验证完整处理
welcome_message.en: Share an API, data, or service problem and I will take it from contract through verification

description.zh: 定义资源、契约、错误和权限
description.en: Define resources, contracts, errors, and authorization

prompt.zh: 请为以下能力设计 API，包含资源模型、请求响应、错误语义、权限、幂等性和测试：
prompt.en: Design an API for this capability, including resources, requests, responses, errors, authorization, idempotency, and tests:

description.zh: 安全设计模式、迁移和回滚
description.en: Safely design schema, migration, and rollback

prompt.zh: 请设计以下数据库变更，说明模式、约束、迁移步骤、兼容窗口、回滚方案和验证查询：
prompt.en: Design this database change with schema, constraints, migration steps, compatibility window, rollback, and verification queries:

description.zh: 从日志、指标和链路定位根因
description.en: Use logs, metrics, and traces to find root cause

prompt.zh: 请系统诊断以下后端故障：建立复现和时间线，分析日志/指标/链路，验证根因后给出最小修复：
prompt.en: Diagnose this backend failure systematically: establish reproduction and timeline, analyze logs/metrics/traces, verify root cause, then propose a minimal fix:

zh: 每天「09:00」汇总后端错误率、慢请求和失败任务
每周三「15:00」检查数据库容量、慢查询与迁移风险
每周五「17:00」复盘本周接口变更和兼容性问题
en: Every day at 09:00, summarize backend errors, slow requests, and failed jobs
Every Wednesday at 15:00, review database capacity, slow queries, and migration risks
Every Friday at 17:00, review API changes and compatibility issues
